goal:
ADM-2: turn ADM-1's public settings page into a private owner console. Owner, 2 Nov: built by Claude, not Codex.

WHY
ADM-1 (#46, merged 833a131) shipped /admin as a public, 7,400 px list of every setting with Edit buttons, linked from the main nav and the wallet panel. The public explanation of the rules now belongs to /how-it-works (docs/visual-concepts/how-it-works-draft.html). The owner needs a compact console that opens on what needs attention. ADM-1's read and signing layer is sound and stays.

KEEP (reviewed on #46)
- admin-settings.ts: lossless JSON for u64 history, the read layer, client-side validation that mirrors the contract, stale-record checks before a tunables edit, owner gating.
- signAndSendAdminChange, its owner and network checks, and the exact-bytes path for large integers (Meteor only until the contract stops requiring history fields in set_tunables).

CHANGE
1. Out of public view: remove /admin from NAV_ITEMS and the wallet-panel link; mark the page noindex. A visitor who opens /admin sees one short paragraph and a link to /how-it-works, not the settings.
2. Owner layout, summary first: a status strip (painting live or paused, NEAR and mPOO price cooldowns, happy hour, mPOO cap left today, next distributions, NEAR waiting on the buyback account), then anything needing action, then a compact grouped table of editable settings with inline edit and preview. Fixed rules and TOILET settings are collapsed and read-only.
3. Pause: one button, always visible to the owner. Before signing, check only the connected wallet and network. No get_owner, get_tunables or staleness gate: an RPC failure must never block the emergency stop.
4. History: fetch once on load and once after a confirmed change. Not on every poll or window focus (ADM-1 sends 7 NearBlocks requests each time).
5. Code: move parseChainJson / stringifyChainJson out of app/ into a neutral module so wallet.ts no longer imports page code. Split admin-page.ts (390 dense lines) into the status strip, the settings table, the editor and the submit flow, written for review.
6. Delete artifacts/adm-1 (about 2.5 MB of PNGs, not used on main). Fix the stale 0.00664 NEAR storage-per-cell string in admin-catalog.ts (the contract value is 0.000664).
7. After toilet-round-board lands: show set_toilet_rate with its guards, and drop max_earning_cells from the catalog. Not before.

ACCEPTANCE
- Visitor view and owner view tests; pause signs with the RPC unreachable; history fetch count asserted; no horizontal overflow at 390 px; npm test and npm run build green.
- The 35 ADM-1 tests for the settings layer keep passing or move with the code.

DO NOT
- No contract changes. Do not loosen any owner or stale-record check except the pause path above.
